flood_event.description: A flash flood hit a 200m stretch of Dunearn Road near Sime Darby Centre at around 9.25am, causing two traffic lanes to be temporarily closed. The flood subsided within 15 minutes.
Flash flood warning issued by PUB urging people to avoid the junction of Mountbatten Road and Tanjong Katong Road South.
Flash flood warning issued covering Craig Road in the Tanjong Pagar area.
Flash flood warning issued covering Jalan Seaview in the Marine Parade area.
Flash flood warning issued covering a section of Jalan Boon Lay in the west.
Flooding occurred at Still Road South and surrounding HDB blocks at Block 66 and 67 Marine Drive due to a damaged water pipe, affecting a lift and a path to the temporary community centre office.

Heavy downpour caused a flash flood along Bukit Timah Road near King Albert Park MRT station due to high water levels in adjacent drains and Bukit Timah Canal. The floodwaters subsided 10 minutes later.
Heavy rain triggered a flash flood at Ophir Road near Bugis.
Flash flood occurred at Wan Tho Avenue in the Potong Pasir area in the afternoon, subsiding within 10 minutes.
Flash flood occurred at Yishun Avenue 7 in the afternoon, subsiding within 10 minutes with assistance provided to motorists.
Heavy downpours triggered flash floods in nearly 20 locations across Singapore, including Toa Payoh, which subsided within 20 minutes.
Flash floods occurred along Dunearn Road and Bukit Timah Road near King Albert Park from about 5pm due to high water levels in nearby drains and Bukit Timah Canal, subsiding in 20 minutes.
Flooding occurred along a stretch of Jalan Seaview due to heavy rain coinciding with a high tide of 2.8m, which temporarily overwhelmed the adjacent canal and surrounding roadside drains.
Flooding occurred on a 15m stretch along the intersection of Mountbatten Road and Jalan Seaview for about two hours due to heavy rainfall and high tide, affecting the road and a nearby property.
Flash flood broke out along Yishun Avenue 7 after heavy rain on Sunday afternoon, subsiding within an hour.
Flash flood broke out along Punggol Way slip road to TPE after heavy rain on Sunday afternoon, subsiding within an hour.
Flash flood broke out along the KPE slip road to Buangkok East Drive after heavy rain on Sunday afternoon, subsiding within an hour.
Flash flood occurred between 5pm and 6pm as heavy rain temporarily overwhelmed the capacity of surrounding drains and canals.
